# Introduction
![XQ Logo](https://xqmessage.com/api/client/img/crossplatform_api.svg)

Welcome to XQ's API documentation!

The XQ API exposes services that enable you to manage all aspects of data privacy within your application. It offers endpoints so your users can authenticate, encrypt/decrypt data, manage encryption keys/identities, and retrieve event logs related to these services.

### What is XQ Message?
XQ Message is an encryption-as-a-service (EaaS) platform which gives you the tools to encrypt and route data to and from devices like mobile phones, IoT, and connected devices that are at the "edge" of the internet. The XQ platform is a lightweight and highly secure cybersecurity solution that enables self protecting data for perimeter-less Zero Trust data protection, even to devices and apps that have no ability to do so natively.


### Philosophy
We’re all about enabling digital privacy. Part of enabling privacy is giving the owner of the data the knowledge that it was read, but also by who, when, and where.

XQ’s Zero Trust Data Platform aims to simplify data security, making it easier to provide privacy to people, organizations, and infrastructure. Web security is weak and easily hacked. VPN security is hard to use, not scalable, and still vulnerable. 

Through our API, XQ provides a data-centric, highly secure model that gives users control of their data. Resilient, data agnostic, and scalable - XQ is cyber security for those who want to control their data wherever it goes.
